data.narrative:
HIMERA is a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by Misha Rudominsky and Oleksiy Oliynyk, having raised $2.5M+. The valuation analysis draws from a universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two valuation methods were triangulated. The Stage-Progression method applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage transitions, using the $2M raised proxy as the base, yielding $6M. The Peer-Median method examines four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: Stark Defence at $4.0B (Series A), UFORCE at $1.0B (Seed), Singularity at $400M (Series A), and NODA AI at $125M (Series A). The median across this peer set is $700M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $5M to $805M, with a median point of $353M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around stage maturity, market traction, and technology differentiation relative to the peer set. The Stage-Progression method produces a conservative floor, while the Peer-Median approach anchors toward higher valuations given UFORCE's $1B Seed valuation. Critical variables for narrowing this range include revenue or deployment metrics, technical defensibility, and customer concentration.
